relevance_note: Single-patient case report of HA20: "This case expands the clinical spectrum of A20 haploinsufficiency" in a 14-year-old boy with a heterozygous loss-of-function TNFAIP3 variant (c.1466_1467delTG, p.V489Afs*7).
method_note: Case report; the whole Markdown file was read (the paper has no '## Supplementary material' section). One in-scope person: the single unnamed patient, labelled 'patient' by label rule 5 (the paper prints no label for him; 'our patient' is not a label). His two parents are described only as healthy, with no statement that they were tested for the variant and no individual-level detail; because the instructions require a checklist row for every individual, they were given rows with 'not reported' values and all-not-reported checklists. In the figure 1A pedigree the first-born infant who died as a result of prematurity has no printed sex and no printed relation to the patient (only 'siblings' are mentioned), so no row was created for that infant. Table 1 is a parameters table with the patient as columns (Pretransplant / Post-transplant), not as rows, and it reports laboratory measurements rather than checklist features. The variant is printed twice, as c.1466_1467TGdel (figure 1A legend) and c.1466_1467delTG (text); the text form is recorded. No parental testing statement is printed, so inheritance is 'not reported' even though the title and text say 'de novo' (rule 8 / D-24); zygosity 'heterozygous' is stated for this patient. The paper never states that this patient was reported earlier, so no re-report. No internal contradiction found. Checklist rows carry null spans for checklist_feature by instruction; 'excluded' was used only where the paper is explicit ('No other autoantibodies were detected'). 'Cytopaenias' was read as cytopenia (autoimmune) and 'enteropathy' as gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation, in the paper's own words. Boolean fields whose value is false (is_proband for the two parents, cites_prior_report_of_same_patients) have no supporting quote and therefore a null span. The spans 'a novel de novo heterozygous 2 bp deletion', '| Anti-GAD antibody (IU/mL) | >2000 | >2000 | 0–9.9 |' and 'We also confirmed enhanced expression of the key NF-κB target gene interleukin 6 (IL-6) at the protein level by ELISA (p=0.0015, figure 1G)' contain the paper's non-ASCII spaces (U+2009 and U+00A0).
